body: ac-00: B07 audit + dual-encoder design. codegraph the consumers of models/model2vec + EMBED_DIM/EMBED_AGG_DIM (value-agg branch, 128-dim header branch, semantic/entity/sense classifiers). Design: 2nd Model2VecResources for the value branch, config-selected (value_embed_model), potion-4M stays for header+classifiers; decide EMBED_DIM/AGG 1024 handling (config vs const) without breaking the 128-dim header. Deliverable: consumer graph + edit set + config-schema change.

ac-01: implement dual-encoder native inference. Binary loads potion-4M (header+classifiers) + potion-8M (value-agg 1024); value model config-selected so v19/m2v-244 unchanged. Place potion-8M artifact + config. VERIFY native potion-8M profiles, native gold composed ~= offline 0.794 + Sense ~= 0.522 (HALT+diagnose if not), v19 unaffected. Tests + B07 + clippy -D + cargo test green.

ac-02 (BLOCKING H05): native corpus-honest gate on potion-8M = the real GO/NO-GO vs v19 (replaces invalid offline gate). gittables_corpus_pass native + corpus_honest_gate vs v19_gated oracle (categorical->word remap). Deliverable: verdict + triggers classified collapse vs over-emit.

ac-03: principled value-rule fixes for blocking triggers, re-gate to GO. Leading-zero numeric_code promotion FIRST (xref t-0000a86b18b9de4d9bff03b8, biggest shared collapse, helps all models). Value-based (0048/0096) + kill switch + ledger per rule. Re-gate native until GO + composed holds. HALT if >~4 rules (fix data drift instead).

ac-04: SHIP if GO + composed holds + scoreboard clean. package -> HF upload -> swap models/default -> potion-8M, version bump, CHANGELOG, count surfaces + latency note, CLAUDE.md (v19 retired -> potion-8M default). Else documented fallback (stay v19; next bet = fix fresh-retrain data drift).
